projects.title: Chess Tournament Management System
projects.description: A modern and responsive Chess Tournament Management System built with Svelte and JavaScript to simplify tournament organization through player management, tournament management, automated match generation, match history, and ranking calculation.
features: Player CRUD operations including creation, viewing, updating, deletion, and search
Tournament creation, editing, deletion, and player registration
Automated random player pairing and match generation
Match result generation and match history persistence
Tournament ranking and leaderboard calculation based on match victories
Responsive desktop, tablet, and mobile interface
Local data persistence using browser Local Storage
Modular player, tournament, match, and ranking modules
projects.architecture: Component-based Svelte architecture organized into reusable common, layout, player, tournament, match, and ranking components, with dedicated pages, services, stores, and utility modules. Application state is managed using Svelte Stores and data is persisted through Local Storage.
projects.challenges: Implemented tournament business logic including player registration, random player pairing, match generation, match result handling, match history, and ranking calculation while maintaining a modular and reusable frontend architecture.
projects.impact: Provides an end-to-end tournament management workflow covering player registration, tournament creation, automated match generation, result tracking, and leaderboard calculation in a responsive web application.
